summary: Wetour Robotics filed a Form 6-K reporting termination of its at-the-market (ATM) equity sales agreement with Chaince Securities, effective five days after notice on August 19, 2026. The company suspended further sales under the agreement, which had generated roughly $2.29 million in gross proceeds from 25.6 million shares since a July 6, 2026 prospectus supplement. This is a routine administrative update regarding an ATM program, not a special situation. There is no board recommendation, premium, or structural complexity; the filing simply documents the end of a capital-raising facility. What to watch is the company's future financing approach, but no risk-arb angle applies.
